lines.en: At the end of every month, I write down what I spent, so I can see where my money went.
It is much easier to save money when you have a clear goal, such as buying a car or travelling.
I used to spend too much on coffee and snacks, until I realized how quickly small amounts add up.
Having a budget does not mean you cannot enjoy life, it simply means you spend with a plan.
She borrowed some money from a friend, and she promised to pay it back by the end of the month.
Prices have gone up so much that many families can no longer afford the things they used to buy.
Before you take a loan, make sure you understand how much interest you will pay in total.
I would rather spend money on experiences than on things that I will forget about in a few months.
Keeping some money aside for emergencies gives you peace of mind, even if you never need to use it.
Being rich is not only about how much you earn, but also about how wisely you manage what you have.
